---- MODULE ivy_examples_tlb ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_tlbDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
AgtPCS == {Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, MainHandleInterrupt, InitiatorDeactivate, InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate}
AgtTypeOK ==
  /\ pc \in [Processor -> AgtPCS]
  /\ userpmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ writepmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ actionlock \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ actionneeded \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ active \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ interrupt \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ currentcpu \in [Processor -> Processor]
  /\ plock \in [PMap -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ tlb \in [Processor -> PageEntry]
  /\ pentry \in [PMap -> PageEntry]
  /\ todo \in [Processor -> [Processor -> BOOLEAN]]
  /\ error \in BOOLEAN
AgtI1 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] = MainCheck => tlb[p] = pentry[userpmap[p]]
AgtJ1 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction} => actionlock[currentcpu[p]]
AgtJ2 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap} => plock[writepmap[p]]
AgtJ3 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in {ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction} => actionlock[p]
AgtI4 == \A p \in Processor : (pc[p] = ResponderLockAction /\ ~plock[userpmap[p]]) => ~actionlock[p]
AgtG1 == \A p \in Processor : (pc[p] \notin {ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction} /\ actionlock[p]) => plock[userpmap[p]]
AgtL2 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in {InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt} => userpmap[currentcpu[p]] = writepmap[p]
AgtM1 == \A p \in Processor : (pc[p] \in {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap} /\ userpmap[p] = writepmap[p]) => ~actionlock[p]
AgtB1 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] = Boot => ~actionlock[p]
AgtN1 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in {InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt} => currentcpu[p] # p
AgtT1 == \A p \in Processor : ~todo[p][p]
AgtO1 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in {InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt} => pc[currentcpu[p]] # Boot
AgtP1 == \A p,q \in Processor : todo[p][q] => pc[q] # Boot
AgtH1 == \A p \in Processor : actionlock[p] => (pc[p] \in {ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction} \/ (\E q \in Processor : pc[q] \in {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction} /\ currentcpu[q] = p))
AgtH2 == \A m \in PMap : plock[m] => (\E p \in Processor : writepmap[p] = m /\ pc[p] \in {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap})
AgtQ1 == \A p,q \in Processor : ((pc[p] \in {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap} /\ pc[q] \in {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap} /\ writepmap[p] = writepmap[q]) => p = q)
AgtR1 == \A p,q1,q2 \in Processor : ((q1 # q2 /\ pc[q1] \in {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction} /\ currentcpu[q1] = p /\ pc[q2] \in {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction} /\ currentcpu[q2] = p) => FALSE)
AgtR2 == \A p,q \in Processor : ((pc[q] \in {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction} /\ currentcpu[q] = p /\ pc[p] \in {ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction}) => FALSE)
AgtC1 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] = MainChoose => tlb[p] = pentry[userpmap[p]]
AgtC2 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] = InitiatorDeactivate => tlb[p] = pentry[userpmap[p]]
AgtC4 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] = ResponderClearActionNeeded => tlb[p] = pentry[userpmap[p]]
AgtC5 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] = ResponderUnlockAction => tlb[p] = pentry[userpmap[p]]
AgtU1 == \A p \in Processor : (pc[p] \notin {Boot, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUpdateEntry} /\ tlb[p] # pentry[userpmap[p]]) => actionneeded[p]
AgtV1 == \A p \in Processor : (pc[p] \notin {Boot, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUpdateEntry, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb} /\ tlb[p] # pentry[userpmap[p]]) => interrupt[p]
AgtAct1 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in {Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, MainHandleInterrupt, InitiatorDeactivate, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate} => active[p]
AgtAct2 == \A p \in Processor : pc[p] \in {InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate} => ~active[p]
AgtW1 == \A p,q \in Processor : (pc[p] = InitiatorUpdateEntry /\ pc[q] = MainCheck) => userpmap[q] # writepmap[p]
AgtW2 == \A p,q \in Processor : (pc[p] = InitiatorUpdateEntry /\ pc[q] = MainChoose) => userpmap[q] # writepmap[p]
AgtW3 == \A p,q \in Processor : (pc[p] = InitiatorUpdateEntry /\ pc[q] = InitiatorDeactivate) => userpmap[q] # writepmap[p]
AgtW4 == \A p,q \in Processor : (pc[p] = InitiatorUpdateEntry /\ pc[q] = ResponderClearActionNeeded) => userpmap[q] # writepmap[p]
AgtW5 == \A p,q \in Processor : (pc[p] = InitiatorUpdateEntry /\ pc[q] = ResponderUnlockAction) => userpmap[q] # writepmap[p]
AgtX1 == \A p,q \in Processor : (pc[p] = InitiatorUpdateEntry /\ pc[q] \notin {InitiatorUpdateEntry, Boot} /\ userpmap[q] = writepmap[p] /\ tlb[q] = pentry[userpmap[q]]) => actionneeded[q]
AgtX2 == \A p,q \in Processor : (pc[p] = InitiatorUpdateEntry /\ pc[q] \notin {InitiatorUpdateEntry, Boot, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb} /\ userpmap[q] = writepmap[p] /\ tlb[q] = pentry[userpmap[q]]) => interrupt[q]
AgtIndInv == AgtTypeOK /\ ~error /\ AgtI1 /\ AgtJ1 /\ AgtJ2 /\ AgtJ3 /\ AgtI4 /\ AgtG1 /\ AgtL2 /\ AgtM1 /\ AgtB1 /\ AgtN1 /\ AgtT1 /\ AgtO1 /\ AgtP1 /\ AgtH1 /\ AgtH2 /\ AgtQ1 /\ AgtR1 /\ AgtR2 /\ AgtC1 /\ AgtC2 /\ AgtC4 /\ AgtC5 /\ AgtU1 /\ AgtV1 /\ AgtAct1 /\ AgtAct2 /\ AgtW1 /\ AgtW2 /\ AgtW3 /\ AgtW4 /\ AgtW5 /\ AgtX1 /\ AgtX2
THEOREM AgtInit == Init => AgtIndInv
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF Init, AgtIndInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtPCS, AgtI1, AgtJ1, AgtJ2, AgtJ3, AgtI4, AgtG1, AgtL2, AgtM1, AgtB1, AgtN1, AgtT1, AgtO1, AgtP1, AgtH1, AgtH2, AgtQ1, AgtR1, AgtR2, AgtC1, AgtC2, AgtC4, AgtC5, AgtU1, AgtV1, AgtAct1, AgtAct2, AgtW1, AgtW2, AgtW3, AgtW4, AgtW5, AgtX1, AgtX2, Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, MainHandleInterrupt, InitiatorDeactivate, InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate, vars
